definitions.explanation: A thick woven floor covering, from wall-to-wall carpet to a large decorative rug.

examples.english: I sat on the carpet and read a book.

examples.japanese: ペルシャ{絨毯|じゅうたん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高価|こうか}→高価：02796_kouka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: Persian carpets are expensive and beautiful.

examples.japanese: {絨毯|じゅうたん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}み{物|もの}→飲み物：02929_nomimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦こぼして→こぼす：02104_kobosu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I spilled a drink on the carpet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{絨毯|じゅうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いたら→敷く：00366_shiku⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ずいぶん→随分：01256_zuibun⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: When I laid a new carpet, the atmosphere of the room changed quite a bit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{絨毯|じゅうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}いておく→敷く：00366_shiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{転|ころ}んでも→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧⟦{痛|いた}くない→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: In homes with children, having a carpet laid down is reassuring because it doesn't hurt when they fall.

notes:
Often written in hiragana, じゅうたん, because the kanji are rare.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絨毯|じゅうたん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{敷|し}く→敷く：00366_shiku⟧: to lay a carpet
- ペルシャ{絨毯|じゅうたん}: a Persian carpet
- {空飛|そらと}ぶ{絨毯|じゅうたん}: a flying carpet
- {赤絨毯|あかじゅうたん}: the red carpet

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦カーペット→カーペット：24239_kaapetto⟧: carpet — the loanword, now the usual word in shops
- ラグ: a smaller rug
- ⟦{敷物|しきもの}→敷物：17130_shikimono⟧: floor covering (the general term)
